instagram.backgroundSync: Sync is running. Come back in a few minutes to see the rest of your posts.
instagram.description: See views, likes, comments and saves for each post.
instagram.syncPending: We’re fetching your posts and their metrics. They’ll appear in Content in a few minutes.
instagram.lastUpdatedUnavailable: The last data refresh time is not available.
instagram.notProfessionalTitle: This account is not (or is no longer) a Professional account.
instagram.notProfessionalHelp: Switch it to Business or Creator in the Instagram app, then reconnect.
instagram.tokenExpired: The connection expired. Disconnect and reconnect Instagram to keep receiving your metrics.
instagram.syncFailed: Sync failed. Try again, or disconnect and reconnect Instagram.
instagram.professionalHelp: Business or Creator. A personal account cannot grant access to these metrics. This is an Instagram limitation, not a Minaly issue.
instagram.professionalGuide: How do I switch to a Professional account?
instagram.guide1: Open the Instagram app and go to your profile.
instagram.guide2: Menu ☰ → Settings and privacy → Account type and tools.
instagram.guide3: Choose Switch to a professional account, then Creator or Business for your activity.
instagram.guide4: Finish the Instagram wizard, then come back here and connect.
instagram.fetchReach: Reach and impressions (when Meta exposes them)
instagram.fetchProfile: Profile visits and follows generated by the post
instagram.neverOutboundClicks: Outbound clicks on an organic post or reel. The Meta API does not expose them.
instagram.securityNote: Your connection is encrypted and read-only. Minaly cannot publish for you, and you can disconnect it at any time. Metrics refresh every 6 hours.
instagram.subscriptionRequired: Content tracking requires an active subscription. Activate your subscription to connect Instagram.

youtube.backgroundSync: Sync is running. Come back in a few minutes to see the rest of your videos.
youtube.description: See views, watch time, retention and CTR for each video.
youtube.syncPending: We’re fetching your videos and their metrics. They’ll appear in Content in a few minutes.
youtube.lastUpdatedUnavailable: The last data refresh time is not available.
youtube.tokenExpired: The connection expired or was revoked. Disconnect and reconnect YouTube to keep receiving your metrics.
youtube.syncFailed: Sync failed. Try again, or disconnect and reconnect YouTube.
youtube.channelRequirementHelp: It must belong to the Google account you connect. Until Google finishes verifying the Minaly app, only added test accounts can connect.
youtube.fetchViews: Views, watch time and average view duration
youtube.fetchSubscribers: Subscribers gained and lost, per video
youtube.neverOutboundClicks: Outbound clicks to an external link. YouTube does not expose them for organic content.
youtube.neverCtr: Thumbnail impressions and click-through rate (CTR). They are available only in Studio.
youtube.securityNote: Your connection is encrypted and read-only. Minaly cannot publish or edit for you, and you can disconnect it at any time. Metrics refresh every 6 hours.
youtube.subscriptionRequired: Content tracking requires an active subscription. Activate your subscription to connect YouTube.

calendly.description: Automatic call-booking tracking. Bookings arrive live. Mark the outcome and amount after each call.
calendly.syncPending: We’re fetching your bookings. They’ll appear in Call tracking within a few minutes.
calendly.apiAccessTitle: Your token works, but API access is not active on your Calendly plan.
calendly.apiAccessHelp: The Calendly API requires a paid plan. Check your plan on calendly.com, then reconnect.
calendly.syncFailed: Sync failed. Disconnect and reconnect Calendly to try again.
calendly.tokenUnreadable: Minaly cannot read the saved token. During a key rotation, set the previous encryption key, or disconnect and reconnect Calendly.
calendly.notTechnical: You do not need technical skills. Follow these steps to retrieve your Calendly token. It takes about a minute.
calendly.step1: Step 1 of 2: retrieve your token in Calendly.
calendly.guide2: Go to Integrations & apps → API & Webhooks.
calendly.guide3: Under Personal access tokens, click Generate new token and name it Minaly.
calendly.guide4: Copy the displayed token (it won’t be visible again).
calendly.step2: Step 2 of 2: paste your Calendly token below.
calendly.securityNote: Your token is encrypted and will never be shown again. It is only used to read your appointments and receive bookings.
calendly.subscriptionRequired: Call tracking requires an active subscription. Activate your subscription to connect Calendly.

iclosed.description: Automatic call-booking tracking. Bookings arrive live. Mark the outcome and amount after each call.
iclosed.syncPending: We’re fetching your booked calls. They’ll appear in Call tracking within a few minutes. Then mark the outcome of each call.
iclosed.apiAccessTitle: Your key works, but API access is not active on your iClosed plan.
iclosed.apiAccessHelp: The iClosed API requires a Business or Enterprise plan. Check your plan on iclosed.io or ask iClosed support to enable API access, then reconnect.
iclosed.syncFailed: Sync failed. Disconnect and reconnect iClosed to try again.
iclosed.tokenUnreadable: Minaly cannot read the saved key. During a key rotation, set the previous encryption key, or disconnect and reconnect iClosed.
iclosed.webhookHelp: In iClosed, open Settings → Developer → Webhooks, add this URL, and select the call events you want to receive. This URL belongs to this connection only. If Webhooks is missing, ask iClosed support to enable it for your plan.
iclosed.copyWebhookFailed: Copy failed. Select the URL and copy it manually.
iclosed.webhookEvents: This URL accepts events for the connected iClosed account only.
iclosed.notTechnical: You do not need technical skills. Follow these steps to retrieve your iClosed key. It takes about a minute.
iclosed.step1: Step 1 of 2: retrieve your key in iClosed. Follow these 4 steps exactly.
iclosed.guide1: Open iClosed and sign in to your account.
iclosed.guide3: Open the Developer tab, then API Keys.
iclosed.guide4: Click Create new key, name it Minaly, then copy the key. It starts with iclosed_.
iclosed.step2: Step 2 of 2: paste your iClosed key below.
iclosed.securityNote: Your key is encrypted and will never be shown again. It is only used to read your calls and receive bookings. Minaly cannot modify anything in iClosed.
iclosed.subscriptionRequired: Call tracking requires an active subscription. Activate your subscription to connect iClosed.
